title: Who's Behind This Page? Learning to Read Sideways
goal: Learn **lateral reading** — the practice of leaving a page to check who's behind it, before deciding whether to trust it — through a worked example and a guided practice scenario. This is the course's mandatory standalone critical-reading module (research/06 §1.9).
newToday: Lateral reading / source-evaluation protocol. This lesson's "extra" slot is the protocol itself — there is no separate syntax focus today.
review: Text structure — **Description**, applied here to evaluating a web page rather than a science topic. All 6 strategies folded in.
